data.title: First-Time International Wire to New Country
data.description: Detects international wire transfers sent to a country that has no prior transaction history for the originating account. First-time international wires, especially to high-risk corridors, are a key indicator of business email compromise and payment diversion schemes.
falsepositives: Companies expanding into new international markets with legitimate vendor payments
Individual customers sending family remittances to a new country for the first time
